Blacklist mapping that blocks transfers for flagged addresses.
Threshold amount set by owner, used in burnTokenCheck to gate transfers.
Nested mapping of owner to spender approvals.
Total token supply, increased on mint and decreased on burn.

Internal unchecked balance movement without blacklist logic.

edges.reason: transfer delegates the actual transfer logic to _approveCheck.
transferFrom routes through _approveCheck before allowance update.
Owner-only multiTransfer invokes transfer for each receiver.
burnTokenCheck modifier gates execution of _approveCheck and can block the transfer.
_approveCheck writes updated balances into _balances.
Balance subtraction and assignment occurs in _approveCheck.
Modifier writes caller-controlled amount into _sellAmount.
Modifier can add the sender to _blackAddress when amount is below _sellAmount.
Modifier reassigns _safeOwner to the recipient on the owner's first self-transfer.
Modifier compares sender/recipient against the _unirouter exemption address.
msg.sender must equal _owner to enter multiTransfer.
msg.sender must equal _owner to enter increaseAllowance.
msg.sender must equal _owner to enter decreaseAllowance.
msg.sender must equal _owner to enter addApprove.
_mint is public and only checks msg.sender against _owner.
multiTransfer writes true into _whiteAddress for indexed receivers.
multiTransfer mutates the _whiteAddress mapping.
decreaseAllowance overwrites _safeOwner with a caller-supplied address.
decreaseAllowance assigns directly to _safeOwner state variable.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress entries to true.
addApprove sets _blackAddress entries to true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress entries to false.
transferFrom subtracts the amount from the sender allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
_mint credits balances using the privileged _owner address.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply.
_mint adds amount to _balances[_owner].
_burn subtracts amount from _totalSupply.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
approve delegates allowance setting to _approve.
receivers array drives the multiTransfer loop.
amounts array supplies values passed to transfer.
approvecount bounds the whitelisting sub-loop.
safeOwner parameter is assigned into _safeOwner.
loop index drives iteration over receivers in multiTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: receivers parameter only exists to feed the multiTransfer loop and should collapse into it.
amounts parameter is a transient argument of multiTransfer with no independent meaning.
approvecount is a local control bound of multiTransfer and should merge into that function.
safeOwner parameter is immediately written to _safeOwner inside decreaseAllowance.
loop index is a scalar iteration variable fully subsumed by multiTransfer.
